title: Tenure Discount Points for Long-Standing Host Accounts
content:
# Host Fees Policy — Tenure Discount on a Re-Rated Percentage (Host Accounts)

**Rule.** When a Host Accounts holder's host service fee is re-rated, a tenure discount of **0.25** percentage points comes off the re-rated percentage for an account opened at least **60** whole calendar months before the re-rating, **0.10** points for an account opened at least **36** but fewer than 60 whole months before, and none otherwise. The discount comes off the percentage the re-rating starts from, once, and is taken off before the re-rated fee is worked out.

Account age is counted in whole calendar months from the account's opening date to the date of the re-rating.

| Whole calendar months since the account was opened | Tenure discount |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 0.25 percentage points |
| 36 to 59 | 0.10 percentage points |
| Fewer than 36 | None |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- An account opened 7 years (84 whole months) before the re-rating: 0.25 points come off the starting percentage; from a starting figure of 15.00%, that discount alone takes 15.00% to 14.75%.
- An account opened exactly 36 whole months before: 0.10 points come off.
- An account opened 35 whole months before: no tenure discount.

The discount is a subtraction of percentage points, not a percentage of the percentage: 15.00% less 0.25 points is 14.75%.
